nodes.label: CLAUDE.md — project instructions / session entry point
nodes.norm_label: claude.md — project instructions / session entry point

nodes.label: Repo layout: v2/ = ACTIVE rebuild, v1/ = FROZEN thesis-era stack (reference only)
nodes.rationale: v1 and v2 share class/file names; isolating v1 as reference-only prevents cross-contamination and phantom v1<->v2 edges; v2 has no imports from v1.
nodes.norm_label: repo layout: v2/ = active rebuild, v1/ = frozen thesis-era stack (reference only)

nodes.label: Session entry point: continue work via dated state-transfer docs in docs/state/ (gitignored, in working tree)
nodes.rationale: Work continues across sessions; the newest dated state doc in docs/state/ is the entry point and must be read before doing anything. These docs are gitignored (present in the working tree, never committed), so a fresh clone starts empty. Frozen handoffs live in docs/handoff/; CLAUDE.md line 1 of that section is updated when a newer doc supersedes.
nodes.norm_label: session entry point: continue work via dated state-transfer docs in docs/state/ (gitignored, in working tree)

nodes.label: Codebase navigation graph (graphify) — a search tool, NOT the v2 Neo4j spine
nodes.rationale: graphify-out/graph.json indexes v2 + the in-repo (gitignored) state/handoff docs (docs/state, docs/handoff) + root canon for code search; it is explicitly unrelated to the v2 Source->File->Chunk->Tag artefact graph and must never be confused with it.
nodes.norm_label: codebase navigation graph (graphify) — a search tool, not the v2 neo4j spine

nodes.label: v1 and v2 kept in SEPARATE graphify graphs (active graph contains NO v1)
nodes.rationale: Shared class/file names across v1 and v2 would fabricate phantom v1<->v2 edges that violate the no-v1-imports rule; the v1 reference graph lives at v1/graphify-out/graph.json and is built on demand only.
nodes.norm_label: v1 and v2 kept in separate graphify graphs (active graph contains no v1)

nodes.label: python refresh_graph.py is the ONLY active-graph rebuild path (never graphify --update)
nodes.rationale: refresh_graph.py scans v2 + root + the gitignored state/handoff docs only and preserves the doc bridge edges; graphify --update drops those bridges; a worklist triggers per-doc model extraction bridging into .concept_index.txt.
nodes.norm_label: python refresh_graph.py is the only active-graph rebuild path (never graphify --update)

nodes.label: Hard rule: Design before build — no pipeline code until the stage's design is signed off
nodes.rationale: Present decided-vs-open per stage and get explicit user sign-off before writing any pipeline code; full version lives in the state doc.
nodes.norm_label: hard rule: design before build — no pipeline code until the stage's design is signed off

nodes.label: Hard rule: v2 graph spine is closed canon — Source->File->Chunk->Tag are the only nodes
nodes.rationale: Hard fields are chunk attributes; never put values, inventories, or mirrors of metadata directories into the graph — the graph is references into untouched raw source, never copies.
nodes.norm_label: hard rule: v2 graph spine is closed canon — source->file->chunk->tag are the only nodes

nodes.label: Hard rule: the model emits no numbers, ever (tagger and interpreter)
nodes.rationale: The chunk description is dead; tags are per-chunk contextual phrases; weights are measured downstream, never emitted by the model.
nodes.norm_label: hard rule: the model emits no numbers, ever (tagger and interpreter)

nodes.label: Hard rule: herb-eval is the canonical Neo4j DB — never query herb (contaminated)
nodes.rationale: herb has gold QA/oracle baked in from an ingestion error; herb-eval is THE canonical DB for stats and eval.
nodes.norm_label: hard rule: herb-eval is the canonical neo4j db — never query herb (contaminated)

nodes.label: Hard rule: talk in plain spoken English, short answers; verify before asserting
nodes.rationale: No jargon walls or spec-sheet dumps; verify claims against the real system/data before asserting.
nodes.norm_label: hard rule: talk in plain spoken english, short answers; verify before asserting

nodes.label: Hard rule: docs track reality — close a decision, update design doc + memory in the same pass
nodes.rationale: Reconcile by removal of dead content, not banners; v1 docs and dated state/handoff docs are frozen and describe that build/that moment.
nodes.norm_label: hard rule: docs track reality — close a decision, update design doc + memory in the same pass

nodes.label: Hard rule: v1<->v2 isolation is explicit-request-gated - never cross unless asked
nodes.rationale: Default workspace is v2; never open, read, or reference v1 code or docs unless the user explicitly asks - and when working in v1, never touch v2 unless explicitly asked. OVERRIDES any grounding/reference pointer in state/handoff docs (e.g. the entry doc's section telling you to read v1 pipeline.py to ground the tag concept).
nodes.norm_label: hard rule: v1<->v2 isolation is explicit-request-gated - never cross unless asked

nodes.label: Hard rule: always refresh the navigation graph after changing files
nodes.rationale: After any edit to v2/, root canon, or the gitignored state/handoff docs, run python refresh_graph.py so the active graphify graph tracks reality; it is the only rebuild path (never graphify --update); process any worklist before the change is done.
nodes.norm_label: hard rule: always refresh the navigation graph after changing files
